raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

`CompressedTensorsW4A4Fp4.process_weights_after_loading` runs a fused NVFP4 linear (`qkv_proj`, `gate_up_proj`,
Qwen3.5's `in_proj_qkvz` / `in_proj_ba`, ...) with the largest `weight_global_scale` divisor of its shards and only
logs a warning when they differ. Every shard with a smaller divisor is then dequantized `gs_shard / gs_max` times too
small.

llm-compressor gives each checkpoint tensor its own global scale unless it fuses them. For example,
`sakamakismile/Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated-NVFP4` (Qwen3.5 architecture) has different scales for `in_proj_qkv` /
`in_proj_z` and `in_proj_b` / `in_proj_a` in all 48 Gated DeltaNet layers. In every layer, one side of each pair is dequantized
x0.36 to x0.99 too small. That changes z (output gate), b (beta) and a (decay) relative to the rest; these are used
without normalization. Generation stays coherent, which is why this is easy to miss.

## Changes

- Keep the GEMM exactly as today (the largest divisor). Record the column ranges of the shards whose divisor differs,
  with the factor `gs_max / gs_shard`, and multiply those output columns in place in `apply_weights`, before adding
  the bias. Adjacent shards with the same factor are merged into one range (e.g. q/k/v of `in_proj_qkvz`).
- It works for any number of partitions and with every NVFP4 linear kernel, because it wraps
  `kernel.apply_weights`. The factors are applied as fp32 scalars.
- Layers with a shared global scale take the unchanged path.
- The warning for mismatched *weight* global scales is removed, because they are now handled. The warning for
  mismatched *input* global scales stays: those cannot be corrected after the GEMM.

Related:
- #47515 uses the same idea for two-partition layers only (3+ partitions keep `.max()`), with a full-output multiply
  by a vector cast to the output dtype. It would fix `in_proj_ba` but not `in_proj_qkvz`.
- #59845 fixes the ModelOpt path at load time by rescaling the e4m3 block scales. For comparison I also measured that
  approach on the compressed-tensors path (results below). If reviewers prefer one policy for both paths, this can
  be switched.
- #55073 is the NVFP4 MoE w13 counterpart.

## Test Plan

    pytest tests/quantization/test_compressed_tensors.py -k fused_shards_keep_global_scales -v
    pre-commit run --files <changed files>

The new test quantizes two and four shards with their own global scales, runs the scheme with the emulation kernel
and compares the result with a per-shard dequantized reference.

End to end on an RTX 5090: `sakamakismile/Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated-NVFP4`, FlashInfer CUTLASS NVFP4 kernel,
Model Runner V2, torch.compile + CUDA graphs. The change was applied to a v0.30.0 install; this file is identical on
main.

## Test Result

- New test: 2 passed (CPU and CUDA). Fails on main (max abs diff 32.9 / 18.6).
- Layer level with the real FlashInfer CUTLASS kernel, 2- and 4-partition layers, M = 1..300: cos 0.999995+ against
  an fp32 per-shard reference; eager and `torch.compile` outputs are identical.
- Model (94 layers rescaled, factors 1.01 to 2.81):

| | wikitext-2 NLL (compiled) | wikitext-2 NLL (eager) | GSM8K 5-shot, chat (1319) |
|---|---|---|---|
| main | 2.0020 | 2.0011 | 94.69 % |
| this PR | 1.9786 | 1.9719 | 95.38 % |
| load-time e4m3 block-scale rescale (alternative) | 1.9809 | 1.9767 | 95.75 % |

  wikitext-2-raw test: 64 x 2048-token windows. GSM8K: `tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py`, chat mode,
  `enable_thinking=False`, max_tokens 512. The GSM8K differences are within about 1 standard error.
- Cost of the rescale (eager, CUDA graph, N=16384 K=5120): +1-3 us per call at M <= 128, +7 % at M = 1024. The
  wikitext prefill run took 8.90 s on main and 9.26 s with the change. Nothing changes for checkpoints with shared
  scales.

---

This PR was prepared with AI assistance (Claude). The tests and measurements above were run on real hardware (RTX 5090).

@@ -15,6 +15,7 @@
     QuantizationStrategy,
     QuantizationType,
 )
+from torch.nn import Parameter
 
 from tests.models.utils import check_logprobs_close
 from tests.quantization.utils import load_model_without_vllm_runner
@@ -24,6 +25,10 @@
 from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear import (
     Fp8BlockScaledMMLinearKernel,
 )
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.nvfp4.base import NvFp4LinearLayerConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.nvfp4.emulation import (
+    EmulationNvFp4LinearKernel,
+)
 from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.scaled_mm import (
     MarlinFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel,
 )
@@ -50,6 +55,11 @@
     find_matched_target,
 )
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.input_quant_fp8 import QuantFP8
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.nvfp4_emulation_utils import (
+    FLOAT4_E2M1_MAX,
+    ref_nvfp4_quant,
+    ref_nvfp4_quant_dequant,
+)
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
     GroupShape,
     QuantKey,
@@ -462,6 +472,74 @@ def test_compressed_tensors_nvfp4(args, dist_init, workspace_init):
     assert qkv_proj.scheme.group_size == 16
 
 
+FLOAT8_E4M3_MAX = torch.finfo(torch.float8_e4m3fn).max
+
+
+def _quantize_nvfp4_shard(w: torch.Tensor):
+    """Quantize like llm-compressor: one global scale (a divisor) per tensor."""
+    global_scale = (FLOAT8_E4M3_MAX * FLOAT4_E2M1_MAX / w.abs().max()).float()
+    fp4, block_scale = ref_nvfp4_quant(w, global_scale, block_size=16)
+    codes = torch.zeros_like(fp4, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    for code, value in enumerate((0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0)):
+        codes[fp4.abs() == value] = code
+    codes |= (fp4 < 0).to(torch.uint8) << 3
+    packed = codes[:, 0::2] | (codes[:, 1::2] << 4)
+    dequant = (fp4.unflatten(-1, (-1, 16)) * block_scale.unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2)
+    return packed, block_scale.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn), global_scale, dequant
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "logical_widths,magnitudes",
+    [([32, 32], [1.0, 3.0]), ([32, 32, 16, 16], [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.3])],
+)
+def test_compressed_tensors_nvfp4_fused_shards_keep_global_scales(
+    monkeypatch, logical_widths, magnitudes
+):
+    """Fused shards quantized with different weight global scales (e.g.
+    in_proj_qkv + in_proj_z of Qwen3.5) must each be dequantized with their
+    own scale."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.compressed_tensors.schemes import (  # noqa: E501
+        compressed_tensors_w4a4_nvfp4 as nvfp4_scheme,
+    )
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        nvfp4_scheme,
+        "init_nvfp4_linear_kernel",
+        lambda use_a16=False: EmulationNvFp4LinearKernel(NvFp4LinearLayerConfig()),
+    )
+    device = "cuda" if current_platform.is_cuda_alike() else "cpu"
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    k = 64
+    shards = [
+        _quantize_nvfp4_shard(torch.randn(n, k, device=device) * m)
+        for n, m in zip(logical_widths, magnitudes)
+    ]
+
+    x = torch.randn(4, k, device=device)
+    input_global_scale = (FLOAT8_E4M3_MAX * FLOAT4_E2M1_MAX / x.abs().max()).float()
+
+    layer = torch.nn.Module()
+    layer.logical_widths = logical_widths
+    layer.input_size_per_partition = k
+    layer.output_size_per_partition = sum(logical_widths)
+    params = {
+        "weight_packed": torch.cat([s[0] for s in shards]),
+        "weight_scale": torch.cat([s[1] for s in shards]),
+        "weight_global_scale": torch.stack([s[2] for s in shards]),
+        "input_global_scale": input_global_scale.repeat(len(shards)),
+    }
+    for name, data in params.items():
+        layer.register_parameter(name, Parameter(data, requires_grad=False))
+    scheme = CompressedTensorsW4A4Fp4()
+    scheme.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+    bias = torch.randn(sum(logical_widths), device=device)
+    out = scheme.apply_weights(layer, x, bias=bias)
+
+    x_dq = ref_nvfp4_quant_dequant(x, input_global_scale, block_size=16)
+    w_ref = torch.cat([s[3] / s[2] for s in shards])
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, x_dq @ w_ref.t() + bias)
+
+
 @pytest.mark.skipif(
     not current_platform.is_cuda() or not current_platform.has_device_capability(90),
     reason="W4A8 FP8 is not yet supported on this GPU type.",

@@ -97,18 +97,15 @@ def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
         layer.weight = layer.weight_packed
         del layer.weight_packed
 
-        # Check for mismatched weight global scales
-        if torch.unique(layer.weight_global_scale).numel() != 1:
-            logger.warning_once(
-                "In NVFP4 linear, the weight global scale is different"
-                " for parallel layers (e.g. q_proj, k_proj, v_proj). This "
-                " will likely result in reduced accuracy. Please verify the model"
-                " accuracy. Consider using a checkpoint with a shared global NVFP4"
-                " scale for fused layers."
-            )
-
-        # Process weight global scale (CT stores as divisors, i.e. 1/scale)
-        weight_global_scale = layer.weight_global_scale.max().to(torch.float32)
+        # Process weight global scale (CT stores as divisors, i.e. 1/scale).
+        # Fused layers (e.g. qkv_proj, gate_up_proj) run one GEMM with the
+        # largest divisor; output columns of shards quantized with a smaller
+        # divisor are rescaled by their exact ratio in apply_weights.
+        shard_divisors = layer.weight_global_scale.to(torch.float32)
+        weight_global_scale = shard_divisors.max()
+        layer.shard_output_scales = _shard_output_scales(
+            layer.logical_widths, shard_divisors.tolist(), weight_global_scale.item()
+        )
         layer.weight_global_scale = Parameter(
             1.0 / weight_global_scale, requires_grad=False
         )
@@ -146,4 +143,30 @@ def apply_weights(
         x: torch.Tensor,
         bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
     ) -> torch.Tensor:
-        return self.kernel.apply_weights(layer=layer, x=x, bias=bias)
+        if not layer.shard_output_scales:
+            return self.kernel.apply_weights(layer=layer, x=x, bias=bias)
+        out = self.kernel.apply_weights(layer=layer, x=x)
+        for start, end, scale in layer.shard_output_scales:
+            out[..., start:end] *= scale
+        if bias is not None:
+            out += bias
+        return out
+
+
+def _shard_output_scales(
+    logical_widths: list[int], shard_divisors: list[float], divisor: float
+) -> list[tuple[int, int, float]]:
+    """Column ranges [start, end) whose shard divisor differs from `divisor`,
+    with the factor that restores their own global scale."""
+    ranges: list[tuple[int, int, float]] = []
+    start = 0
+    for width, shard_divisor in zip(logical_widths, shard_divisors):
+        end = start + width
+        if shard_divisor != divisor:
+            scale = divisor / shard_divisor
+            if ranges and ranges[-1][1] == start and ranges[-1][2] == scale:
+                ranges[-1] = (ranges[-1][0], end, scale)
+            else:
+                ranges.append((start, end, scale))
+        start = end
+    return ranges
